headline: 仙逆剧场版领跑，Kill Jackie首播
summary: 本周《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑电影热作；新剧《Kill Jackie》首播，热播剧《侠探杰克》持续吸睛；《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》等待映大片受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《牢笼鬼魂》《重生2》
industryHighlights.en: Film hits: Xian Ni Movie: Slaying Immortals, The Digger, The Nonexistent Sinner, Ghost in the Cage, Rebirth 2

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《Kill Jackie》《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》
industryHighlights.en: New series premieres: Kill Jackie, Coven Academy, Best Equipped

headlineEn: Xian Ni movie leads as Kill Jackie premieres
summaryEn: This week, Xian Ni Movie: Slaying Immortals leads film hits; new series Kill Jackie premieres while hit show Reacher stays in focus; upcoming films like Avengers 5 and Dune 3 draw attention.
